messages.author: 4930488f69589d77
messages.subject: Constrain the Logit Scale
parts:
All,

I am using logistic regression in INLA to analyze binary data. Is there a way to constrain the logit scale from -7 to +7 or constrain  the probability scale from 0.001 to 0.999? Thanks in advance for the help.

Dan

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Constrain the Logit Scale
parts:
Depends on why you want to do this.

If it is to avoid crazy results/overfitting, I would strongly recommend using sensible priors instead of restricting the logit scale.

If you have too many fixed effects, creating a sensible prior for them can be difficult.

Haakon

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Constrain the Logit Scale
parts:
Haakon and Harvard,

In my presence/absence data, I had high spatial autocorrelation over 1k and no autocorrelation out to 150km. The inla.spde2.matern function was not working for my data (imprecise estimates of hyperparmaters and negative SD), and I thought about constraining on the logit scale. Following your advice I was able to use the inla.spde2.pc matern function with constrained priors, which resolved the spatial autocorrelation and provided reasonable results.  Thanks for the help and advice.
Dan
